Our Story

The Turkeys are coming!!

Order your Thanksgiving Turkey Now!!  Supplies are limited!

The turkeys will be between 15-22 pounds.

Please use our Order Form to reserve your Thanksgiving Turkey.  No deposit required!

They will be frozen!  You can pick them up at Farmer’s Markets in plenty of time to thaw and cook for your big feast!!

Don’t miss out!  Only 4 weeks left! 

UPDATE—–Sunset Valley Market—–UPDATE

Richardson Farms will no longer market our products or have a booth at the Sunset Valley Farmer’s Market as of today (09/22/2026).

We cordially invite all of our Sunset Valley customers to please shop with us at the Barton Creek Farmer’s Market, every Saturday from 9:00am to 1:00pm.

Thank you!

Grass Fed & Pasture Raised Animals
OUR COMMITMENT STARTS WITH OUR ANIMALS
They are never given antibiotics or hormones!
A place where a pig can be a pig… and a cow can be a cow. 
Grass-Fed Beef

Our cattle are entirely raised on pastures, enjoying the grasses on our fields.

Pasture Raised Pork

Our pigs get to live and play in open fields and enjoy nature like every pig should.

They are never held in confinement.

Pasture Raised Poultry

Our poultry is allowed to enjoy the pastures just like the cows and pigs!

They are able to forage and eat bugs and grasses like chickens and turkeys should.

About Us

The farm is owned and operated by Jim and Kay Richardson!

Jim is a retired Veterinarian and Kay is a retired Registered Nurse.

Jim has always had a passion for farming. He grew up in north Texas, often helping his grandfather on his farm. His lifelong love for animals and farming led Jim, and Kay to build and create Richardson Farms.

The animals are never fed hormones or antibiotics. They get to enjoy the great outdoors and forage in the fields.

A place where a pig can be a pig… and a cow can be a cow. 
Contact Us

Richardson Farms is located in Milam County Texas, approximately 20 miles north of Rockdale.

Our address is:
3126 County Road 412, Rockdale, TX 76567
